items.title: Jersey Mike’s Is Taking Orders on Wall Street
items.summary: Jersey Mike's has gone public. Shares of the sub giant are due to start trading today on the New York Stock Exchange after about 43.5 million shares priced at $23 each yesterday. The company raised about $1 billion in its IPO.
